ownerDecisions.decision: qualk8s_runtime_t gets bpf prog_load, CAP_BPF and prog_run on its own programs only, no maps, no access to planeon cgroups, pins or containment programs. Re-confirmed after review R7 at its real scope: the runtime is a trusted backend component for its BPF use, controlled by W03 runtime selection (cgroup-device programs only, cgroupfs driver), T04 and a W02a-F effective-program census of planeon cgroups
